title: Membership determined by the truncated run
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, $V$ a language of bit strings, and $x$ an input. Suppose that for every string $u$ of length $Q$, $x$ followed by $u$ belongs to $V$ exactly when the run of $N$ on $x$ under choices $u$ halts and outputs the single-bit string true. If every run on $x$ under a choice string of length $T$ halts and $T\le Q$, then for every choice string $r$ of length $Q$, $x$ followed by $r$ belongs to $V$ exactly when the run under the first $T$ bits of $r$ outputs true.
hypotheses_covered: The membership equivalence holds for all $u$ of length $Q$
